; PROBE (temporary): what does BatteryManager expose for steering sleep, and is the
; "keep content visible" toggle (lightSleepEnabled?) readable from QML?
; READ-ONLY: enumerates properties/methods and logs typeof — never assigns, never calls.
; Deployed manually, removed after reading the journal.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: sleepApiProbe
				visible: false

				function dump(name, obj) {
					if (obj === undefined || obj === null) {
						console.log("SLEEPPROBE " + name + ": <unavailable>");
						return;
					}
					var keys = [];
					try { for (var k in obj) keys.push(k + "=" + (typeof obj[k])); } catch (e) { }
					// chunk: journald truncates very long lines
					var line = "";
					for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
						line += keys[i] + " ";
						if (line.length > 400) {
							console.log("SLEEPPROBE " + name + ": " + line);
							line = "";
						}
					}
					if (line !== "") console.log("SLEEPPROBE " + name + ": " + line);
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 4000
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						sleepApiProbe.dump("BatteryManager", BatteryManager);
						try { console.log("SLEEPPROBE displayState=" + BatteryManager.displayState
							+ " displaySleeping=" + BatteryManager.displaySleeping
							+ " Normal=" + BatteryManager.Normal
							+ " LightSleep=" + BatteryManager.LightSleep
							+ " DeepSleep=" + BatteryManager.DeepSleep); } catch (e) {
							console.log("SLEEPPROBE displayState read failed: " + e); }
						try { sleepApiProbe.dump("Settings", Settings); } catch (e) {
							console.log("SLEEPPROBE Settings: <not in scope>"); }
						try { console.log("SLEEPPROBE Settings.lightSleepEnabled="
							+ Settings.lightSleepEnabled
							+ " idleSuspendDelay=" + Settings.idleSuspendDelay); } catch (e) {
							console.log("SLEEPPROBE Settings props failed: " + e); }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
